author: Dragonfirewolf2
name: MoonlightWhois
short: Rich profile viewer with Discord / Roblox / RoTector tabs.
description: Provides /whoami and /profile commands with a multi-tab embed: Discord info, Roblox account + group ranks, and RoTector safety check. Requires RobloxVerify for Roblox data lookup. Group list is configurable per-guild.
